How the Open Payment Provider Fee Works

BigCommerce charges a monthly fee on self-service plans (Core, Growth, and Scale) for orders processed through Open Payment Providers. This fee is billed by BigCommerce directly to you, not your shoppers, and appears as a separate line item on your monthly invoice. It’s separate from any fees your payment provider charges.

Each order is attributed to the payment provider that processes it. For example, if an Embedded Payment Provider processes the order, no fee applies to that transaction. If all orders are processed through Embedded Payment Providers, your fee is $0.

answer.value: BigCommerce plans are based on your trailing twelve-month (TTM) GMV. As your sales grow and exceed your plan’s threshold (for example, $30K on Core or $100K on Growth), you’ll be notified and automatically upgraded to the next plan to support your growth. Scale plan: Starting at $399/month (or $299/month billed annually) for up to $33,333/month in GMV. 0.9% overage rate applies on GMV above $33,333/month — no tier jumps, no block charges. GMV applies a 10% reduction to gross order value. This number may differ from what you track in your own records. That difference is expected, not an error. ***To qualify for the PayPal Braintree rate, here are the details and your next steps.

The processing fee for debit and credit cards begins at 2.89% + $0.29 per transaction for all BigCommerce plans. You will find each plan’s pricing here. Based on your plan, you may be eligible for that plan’s published processing rate. Eligibility requires that you must be a United States-based business. Then,

(1) If you are a new BigCommerce Merchant using a trial PayPal Braintree account, you will need to select a qualifying BigCommerce Plan (Growth, Scale, or Performance). Go into your BigCommerce account Client Area and accept the terms of the selected BigCommerce plan and establish a billing agreement. You will then be charged the first month’s fee for your BigCommerce plan, and you will become eligible to apply for the negotiated payment processing rates with PayPal Braintree. If you are an existing BigCommerce Merchant already in a Growth, Scale, or Performance plan, you do not need to complete this step.

(2) From within the BigCommerce account Control Panel Payment Settings area, complete and submit the PayPal Braintree application to upgrade from a trial to a full account. Additional information may be requested from the PayPal Braintree team during the process of reviewing your application.

(3) 2 to 3 business days following your approval* for a PayPal Braintree account, you will be emailed a Pricing Contract to digitally sign. We suggest adding echosign@echosign.com to your email whitelist to reduce the risk of it going to your spam folder. Follow the instructions in the email on how to sign and return the contract.

(4) Your account will then be updated to reflect the new rate, and you will receive a notification email with the updated rate, which can take up to 10 business days. Your new rate will only apply to transactions after the date on your notification email.

Application for a PayPal Braintree account does not guarantee approval. Periodically, PayPal Braintree reviews its customer accounts to make sure its services and rates fit your account activity. PayPal Braintree reserves the right to revise its fees at any time, subject to a thirty (30) day notice period to you prior to the new fees taking effect.
The standard online rate for payments with American Express is and will continue to be 3.50% with no fixed fee after August 2, 2021.

consentPreferenceCenter.title: Privacy Preference Center
consentPreferenceCenter.description: When you visit any website, it may store or retrieve information on your browser, mostly in the form of cookies. This information might be about you, your preferences or your device and is mostly used to make the site work as you expect it to. The information does not usually directly identify you, but it can give you a more personalized web experience. Because we respect your right to privacy, you can choose not to allow some types of cookies. Click on the different category headings to find out more and change our default settings. However, blocking some types of cookies may impact your experience of the site and the services we are able to offer.

strictlyNecessary.title: Strictly Necessary Cookies
strictlyNecessary.description: These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. They are usually only set in response to actions made by you which amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in or filling in forms. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies, but some parts of the site will not then work. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable information.

functional.title: Functional Cookies
functional.description: These cookies enable the website to provide enhanced functionality and personalisation. They may be set by us or by third party providers whose services we have added to our pages. If you do not allow these cookies then some or all of these services may not function properly.

performance.title: Performance Cookies
performance.description: These cookies allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site. They help us to know which pages are the most and least popular and see how visitors move around the site. All information these cookies collect is aggregated and therefore anonymous. If you do not allow these cookies we will not know when you have visited our site, and will not be able to monitor its performance.

targeting.title: Targeting Cookies
targeting.description: These cookies may be set through our site by us and/or our third-party service providers. They may be used by us and/or our third-party service providers to build a profile of your interests and show you relevant adverts on other sites and/or devices. If you do not allow these cookies, you will experience less targeted advertising.
